title: The coord hook's SessionStart saves the lease token only after its post and digest calls, so a hook killed at its 10 s timeout loses a lease the store accepted
goal: coord_hook.session_start saves the state with the lease token right after the claim or renew returns, before announce and overlaps make their coord calls, so a hook killed at its settings timeout (10 s, while each coord call may take 8 s and retry_releases runs first) keeps a lease the store accepted and the next renew finds it. Found by the SP-4cc36epy review (S3, BG-ljlj77kd "The coord hook drops its lease token when a coord.py call times out").
